senses.gloss:
एत mfn. (-तः-ता or -ती-तं) Of a variegated colour. (-तः-ता-तं) Arrived,
come.
 m. (-तः)
 1. A deer or antelope.
 2. A variegated colour.
 E. इण्
to go, तन् affix; when signifying colour, the fem. affix is either
टाप् or ङीप्, and before the latter, त is changed to न.

एतद् pron.
 mfn. (एषः एषा एतद् or एतत्) This.
 E. एत derived from इण् to
go, and तद् Unādi aff.

एतन m. (-नः) Expiration, breathing out, discharging air from the
lungs.
 E. इण् to go, तनन् aff.

एतर्हि ind. Now, at this time.
 E. एत substituted for इदम्. and र्हिल् aff.

एतश m. (-शः) A Brahman.
 E. इण् to go, and तश Unādi aff.

एतशस् m. (-शाः) A Brahman or man of the first class.
 E. इण् to go, तशस् aff.

एतादृश् mfn. (-दृक्) Such, such like.
 E. एतद् this. दृश् to see, क्विप् aff.

एतादृश mfn. (-शः-शी-शं) Such, such like.
 E. एतद् this, दृश् to see, कञ् aff.

एतावत् mfn. (-वान्-वती-वत्) So many, so much, so far. ind. (-वत्) So far,
thus far, so much, &c.
 E. एतद्, and मतुप् or वति aff.
